decks.notes: The primary focus of this deck is to quickly fill the graveyard with spells in order to bring back Arclight Phoenix multiple times, overwhelming the opponent with aggressive plays and efficient card draw. The deck utilizes cantrips like Consider and Opt to dig for key cards, as well as disruptive spells like Spell Pierce to protect its threats. Picklock Prankster and Ledger Shredder provide additional graveyard synergy, while Treasure Cruise and Profit's Eidetic Memory ensure that the deck can maintain its momentum throughout the game.

The Selesnya Aggro deck focuses on quickly developing a board presence through low-cost creatures like Llanowar Elves and Elvish Mystic, while utilizing cards like Collected Company to put multiple threats onto the battlefield at once. The deck also features powerful synergies with cards like Bishop of Wings, Righteous Valkyrie, and Resplendent Angel to gain life and buff creatures. With a mix of efficient creatures, powerful enchantments, and disruptive spells like Skyclave Apparition, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a fast and aggressive game plan.

This deck focuses on using Greasefang and Parhelion II to create a powerful combo that can overwhelm opponents. The main strategy involves setting up the necessary cards while using control elements like Thoughtseize and Duress to disrupt the opponent's game plan. Cards like Skysovereign, Consul Flagship and Witherbloom Command provide additional value and utility to further strengthen the deck's position. The deck aims to outvalue and outmaneuver opponents by efficiently utilizing its resources and carefully planning out its combos.

This deck focuses on using ramp cards and control elements to quickly bring out powerful creatures like Omnath, Locus of Creation and Atraxa, Grand Unifier. The strategy revolves around generating mana quickly with cards like Lotus Cobra and Sylvan Caryatid, while also disrupting the opponent's game plan with spells like Portable Hole and Get Lost. Yorion, Sky Nomad serves as a companion to provide additional value. Overall, the deck aims to outpace the opponent with its ramp and overwhelm them with its powerful creatures and control elements.

The deck focuses on controlling the game through a combination of counterspells, removal spells, and card advantage. It aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while gradually building card advantage with cards like Teferi, Hero of Dominaria and Dig Through Time. The deck also includes various board wipes like Supreme Verdict to deal with threats on the battlefield. Additionally, it incorporates graveyard hate with cards like Cling to Dust and main deck cards like Pest Control to disrupt the opponent's strategies. The mana base is designed to support the deck's heavy reliance on multicolor spells.

This Jund Aggro deck focuses on sacrificing creatures to trigger powerful effects and disrupt the opponent's game plan. By combining Cauldron Familiar and Witch's Oven with Mayhem Devil and Bloodtithe Harvester, the deck creates a loop of damage and resource advantage. Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Ygra, Eater of All provide additional threats that can quickly close out the game. Deadly Dispute and Scavenger's Talent offer versatility and disruption, while Fatal Push and Claim the Firstborn provide removal options. The deck aims to pressure the opponent early and maintain control of the board throughout the game.

This deck aims to quickly ramp up mana using Lotus Field and various untap effects, such as Hidden Strings and Vizier of Tumbling Sands, to cast powerful spells like Omniscience and Emergent Ultimatum. The deck also includes key cards like Thespian's Stage and Bala Ged Recovery for added consistency and recursion. By using combo pieces and utility lands, the deck can overwhelm opponents with a consistently high mana output and powerful card advantage. The focus is on setting up and executing a game-winning combo while maintaining control of the board with versatile spells and lands.

This deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and aggressive strategy while utilizing Azorius tempo and spirit synergies. By combining disruptive cards like Spell Queller and Skyclave Apparition with evasive spirits like Mausoleum Wanderer and Supreme Phantom, the deck aims to control the board and quickly close out games. Cards like No More Lies and Wedding Announcement provide additional value and flexibility, while cards like Portable Hole and Invasion of Gobakhan help deal with threats efficiently. The deck's mana base is carefully constructed to support its aggressive game plan.

This deck focuses on utilizing Collected Company to quickly deploy a board full of aggressive creatures, backed up by disruptive spells like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Elite Spellbinder. The mana base is designed to support the early game plays while still allowing for consistent access to white and green mana sources. By efficiently deploying threats and disrupting the opponent's game plan, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent and secure a quick victory through a combination of combat damage and tempo advantage.

This deck aims to overwhelm opponents with aggressive creatures in the Selesnya color combination, focusing on putting pressure on the opponent quickly and efficiently. By utilizing cards like Collected Company and Elite Spellbinder to disrupt the opponent's game plan while deploying threats such as Aven Interrupter and Skyclave Apparition, the deck looks to control the board and deal damage early and often. With a solid mana base and a mix of disruptive and evasive creatures, this deck aims to outpace opponents and secure victories through efficient beatdown tactics.

This Jund aggro deck focuses on creating a fast and aggressive board presence with cards like Bloodtithe Harvester, Cauldron Familiar, and Mayhem Devil. By using sacrifice effects such as Deadly Dispute and Witch's Oven, the deck aims to control the board while dealing damage to the opponent. The inclusion of Ygra, Eater of All and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker provides additional threats and disruption. With the support of powerful removal spells like Fatal Push and Claim the Firstborn, this deck looks to overwhelm opponents quickly and efficiently.

The main goal of this deck is to aggressively play Arclight Phoenix from the graveyard by casting multiple spells in a single turn to trigger its ability. The deck includes efficient spells like Consider, Opt, and Lightning Axe to enable this strategy. Additionally, Picklock Prankster and Ledger Shredder help to fill the graveyard with spells. The deck also includes disruptive cards like Spell Pierce to protect the Phoenix and control the opponent's plays. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with quick and powerful spells while maintaining control over the game.

The main focus of this aggro Arclight Phoenix deck is to quickly fill the graveyard with spells to bring back Arclight Phoenix from the graveyard and apply early pressure on the opponent. The deck includes a mix of cheap spells, card draw cards, and ways to protect your creatures. By utilizing cards like Lightning Axe, Fiery Impulse, and Treasure Cruise, players can quickly fill their graveyard and bring back Arclight Phoenix for repeat damage. The inclusion of Picklock Prankster and Ledger Shredder helps enable this strategy while maintaining tempo and aggression.

This deck focuses on using cards like Indomitable Creativity and Transmogrify to cheat powerful creatures onto the battlefield, creating a combo to overwhelm the opponent. It also includes cards like Shark Typhoon for additional value and protection. The deck thrives on creative ways to generate advantage while disrupting the opponent's game plan with counter magic and removal spells. The combination of creatures like Atraxa, Grand Unifier and Mirrex provide additional synergy and power to the deck, making it a versatile and unpredictable force to be reckoned with.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly and aggressively play Arclight Phoenix and other evasive threats in order to deal damage to the opponent as quickly as possible. With a combination of card draw, removal spells, and disruptive spells, the deck aims to maintain tempo and pressure the opponent consistently. The inclusion of Ledger Shredder and Picklock Prankster helps to enable the graveyard recursion of Arclight Phoenix, while also providing additional utility and disruption. The deck aims to close out games quickly by overwhelming the opponent with efficient threats and disruptive spells.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with aggressive creatures and burn spells. The deck includes cards that can deal direct damage with abilities like Monstrous Rage and Titan's Strength, as well as creatures that can grow with spells like Might of the Meek. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion allows for additional mana acceleration. The deck aims to maintain constant pressure on the opponent and finish the game quickly before the opponent can stabilize.
